entries.english:
Hohenfurt grants the market of Ober-Haid and the village of Gerbetschlag, and additionally undertakes to pay annual sums until completion of the monastery and five talents in perpetuity.

Lest reasonable and proper deeds of men suffer loss over time through forgetfulness or false accusation, the prudent authority of our forebears has provided the remedy of written record and the testimony of witnesses. Therefore, let those now living and those to come know that I, Heinrich von Rosenberch, setting out on the Austrian campaign, carefully reflected that the fortunes of war are uncertain and the sword now strikes one man, now another. Entrusting myself to the prayers of the venerable brothers at Hohenfurt, whose intercession for my salvation I am glad to have, I have transferred to the house of St Mary at Hohenfurt, to be held in perpetuity, from the goods granted to me by God and my ancestors, the market in Merica and the village in Gerbrehtslag, with all their appurtenances—woods, groves, meadows, pastures, cultivated and uncultivated fields, roads and trackless places—and two thirds of the tithe of the aforesaid possessions, namely with two sheaves, for the remedy of my soul and those of my ancestors, but on this condition: if I should be called from this life during that campaign. I acknowledge that I am bound by these debts: first, thirty-six marks to Lord Benata, burgrave, for which I pledged him the village of Atez; also twelve marks and twenty talents to Jacob Lednicer, for which I pledged him the village where he resides; seven fertones to Ulrich von Wischel; twenty talents to Alwik, for which I pledged him the village at Schillte; sixteen talents to Moisio, for which I pledged him the village at Chaltenbrunne; ten marks and eight talents to Wernhard Turdlinger, for which I pledged him the village at Cyringe; thirteen talents to Ulrich Lednicer; six talents to Ulrich, the senior judge; and to the monastery of St Mary the Virgin at Hohenfurt, ten marks each year until the work is completed and five talents outright. So that these provisions remain in force, I have had this charter written concerning them and strengthened by the protection of my proper seal. Witnesses: Lord Benata, burgrave; Lord Andreas, miles; and Lord Rûdgerus de Haichpach. Done in the year of the Lord 1278, in the sixth indiction, at Rosenberch on the feast of St Margaret, virgin.
